card.title: Fake the Expertise
card.instruction: Perform expertise so confidently that no one questions you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll tune your violin for the audition. I work by ear.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've tightened that string until it snapped.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That string couldn't hold pitch. I've saved you a failure onstage.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The audition panel heard it snap. They're asking if you know what you're doing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I rejected an unreliable string. Ask for their spare violin; I'll check that one before I approve it.

mechanism: A performs authority over violin tuning by reclassifying damage as quality control and demanding another instrument to approve.
confusable: Unlike admitting a mistake while helping, A must make even the challenge evidence of their expertise.
comparison: D18-b controls an audition panel's spare instrument request; D18-a controls a boiler engineer's communication.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
